name: SaveOutlookEmailMessages
label: Save Outlook Email Messages
description: Saves selected Outlook email messages (.msg files) to a specified location.

fields.name: OutlookApplication
fields.label: Outlook Application
fields.description: The Outlook Application object used to access mail items.

fields.name: EmailMessages
fields.label: Email Messages
fields.description: A list of MailItem objects representing the emails to save.

fields.name: SaveLocation
fields.label: Save Location
fields.description: The folder path where the .msg files should be saved.
